title: Low-Cost Jailbreak Detection vs. Adaptive Attacker: Arms Race Dynamics on a Budget

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing three detectors (PPL, TF-IDF+SVM, linear probe) is individually manageable, but running adaptive attacks against each adds complexity. The adaptive attack optimization loop requires some ML sophistication.
